Amsterdam UMC (location AMC)
Department of Radiology
Date: 21 Nov 2024
Exam: mpMRI prostate

Clinical indication: PSA 8.7 ng/mL, prior biopsy Gleason 3+5. Evaluate for focal lesion and staging.

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume measures 23.0 mL. T2-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal area of low signal intensity in the left peripheral zone extending into the adjacent transition zone, measuring approximately 14 x 12 mm. On diffusion-weighted imaging, this region shows marked restricted diffusion with corresponding low ADC values. Dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences reveal early, intense enhancement of the same focus. No extracapsular extension, seminal vesicle invasion, or suspicious lymphadenopathy is identified. The remainder of the gland appears unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:
Focal lesion in the left peripheral/transition zone, PI-RADS 5.
Prostate volume 23.0 mL, PSA density 0.4 ng/mL/mL.
Clinical stage cT1c.
csPCa predicted probability 0.8609265.

previous_notes.text: 06 May 2024 - Dr. P. van Dijk (GP): Patient presented for routine follow-up. PSA measured at 6.3 ng/mL, representing a rise from previous values. Discussed the recent biopsy results showing Gleason 3+5 disease. Referred to urology for specialist re-evaluation and management planning. Advised patient to monitor for any urinary or systemic symptoms in the interim.

pathology_report:
Biopsy specimen (oldest timepoint): Histological examination reveals adenocarcinoma of the prostate with a Gleason score of 3+5, corresponding to ISUP grade group 4. The tumour exhibits an acinar growth pattern, partly cribriform. A cribriform pattern is present as a high-risk feature. Perineural invasion is confirmed. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone and transition zone on the left side.

Biopsy specimen (latest timepoint): Histological examination reveals adenocarcinoma of the prostate with a Gleason score of 3+5, corresponding to ISUP grade group 4. The tumour exhibits an acinar growth pattern, partly cribriform. A cribriform pattern is present as a high-risk feature. Perineural invasion is confirmed. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone and transition zone on the left side.

Summary: The histological findings across timepoints remain stable, with persistent ISUP grade group 4 disease, cribriform architecture, and perineural invasion.
